subject: GLM-5.2 OFFCUT walkthrough recorder (submission/WALKTHROUGH-NARRATION.json, submission/WALKTHROUGH-README.md, scripts/record-walkthrough.cjs)

blockers.title: Narration timestamps are offset by page-load time (audio/video misalignment)
blockers.detail: runFlow sets t0 = Date.now() after launchBrowser and after page.goto returns. Playwright recordVideo begins at page creation, so the WebM contains the pre-t0 page-load seconds. Because assemble() delays each AIFF by timeline[i].start (relative to t0), every narration segment plays late in the final MP4 by the duration of the initial goto (commonly 1-4s). This violates the requirement that the audible track is delayed by scene timestamps matching the recorded video, and breaks caption/narration sync.
blockers.fix: scripts/walkthrough-patch.json operation 1-2: capture videoStart immediately after launchBrowser in record() and pass it into runFlow so t0 equals video-recording start.

blockers.title: ffmpeg cannot stream-copy VP8 into MP4
blockers.detail: Playwright recordVideo produces WebM with VP8 video. assemble() uses '-c:v copy' into an .mp4 output. ffmpeg rejects VP8 in the MP4 container ('Could not find tag for codec vp8 in stream #0'), so the assemble step will always exit non-zero and no MP4/manifest can ever be produced. The requirement for a stable, verifiable final artifact is unmet.
blockers.fix: scripts/walkthrough-patch.json operation 3: transcode video to H.264/yuv420p (the bundled imageio-ffmpeg binary includes libx264 and aac) instead of stream-copying VP8 into MP4.

patch_status.summary: The three script patches from scripts/walkthrough-patch.json were mechanically applied. Blockers B1 and B2 are patched. Runtime verification (rehearse, record, assemble, manifest check) is still pending and has not been run; blockers are not cleared or verified yet.

nonblocking: Stale-webm handling: if artifacts/walkthrough/video.webm exists from a prior run, record() reuses it instead of the new recording. Consider deleting video.webm and any *.webm in ART before recording.

synthesizeVoice(narration.scenes, false) reuses existing voice/*.aiff even if WALKTHROUGH-NARRATION.json text changed since they were synthesized; stale narration audio would not be detected. Consider regenerating when narration text differs.
The MP4 resolution check regex /(\d{3,4})x(\d{3,4})/ matches the first WxH anywhere in ffmpeg stderr (e.g. configuration banner); a stricter match on the Video: stream line would be more robust.
Rehearsal receipt does not bind the narration content (e.g. hash of scene texts), so --record can run against a receipt produced with different narration.
The README says '-c:v copy'-style 'muxed' wording; after B2 fix the step is a transcode - wording only, no behavior impact.
MIN total duration (125s) is only enforced in assemble(); a too-short recording is detected late. Acceptable since it fails loudly.
